## Prices for 2027

Prices are per person in US dollars for the 5-day / 4-night programme.

| Occupancy | Price per person |
|---|---:|
| SGL, single occupancy | $2530 |
| DBL, double occupancy | $3267 |
| TPL, triple occupancy | $2423 |

The source table lists DBL at a higher price than SGL. These values have been retained; the rate and corresponding room occupancy must be confirmed before booking. Specific departure dates and the hotel name are agreed on request.

## Meals and transfers

The package includes daily breakfast and 1 lunch. The itinerary does not specify which day the lunch takes place, while the conditions for individual excursions list meals as an additional expense. The included lunch and all other meals must be agreed before booking.

Airport transfers are private, and the excursions on days 2–4 are shared. The guide conducts the excursions in English and Spanish.

## Extend your journey

After Oaxaca, you can separately book a trip to Mérida, a journey through Chiapas with a stop in Mexico City, or a stay on the Riviera Maya followed by travel to Mérida. These extensions are not included in the price of this programme.
